   - Initiates download named `{project.title}_case_study.pdf`.

Also, I will add `html2pdf` to the `Window` interface in `types.ts` to avoid type errors.


**Finalizing PDF Generation Method**

I've been working on a more robust approach for generating the PDF. I'll create a hidden div element dynamically, populate it with the HTML string (reusing existing logic), style it specifically for PDF output, and then pass this element to `html2pdf`.
